# Project Phoenix v45.0 — Global Situation 4: Dawn of Proto-Industrialization (1750-1836).
# Pure native EU5 1.4.9 Interactive Situation (`is_data_map = yes`, live `oe_v45_ind_index` 0..100).
# Generated by gen_v450_world_situations.py; edit the generator, not this file.

oe_sit_v45_proto_industrialization = {
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_unique
	hint_tag = hint_oe_sit_v45_proto_industrialization

	can_start = {
		current_year >= 1750
		current_year <= 1836
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v45_ind_ended }
		OR = {
			current_age_or_later = { age = age_6_revolutions }
			any_country = {
				is_rebel_country = no
				num_locations >= 12
				average_country_literacy >= 25
				any_owned_location = {
					OR = {
						raw_material ?= goods:coal
						raw_material ?= goods:iron
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	visible = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
		NOT = { country_type = pop }
		NOT = { country_type = building }
		OR = {
			is_ai = no
			is_great_power = yes
			average_country_literacy >= 20
			any_owned_location = {
				OR = {
					raw_material ?= goods:coal
					raw_material ?= goods:iron
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 1: Vanguard of the Steam & Iron Age (oe_v45_ind_index >= 85)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v45_ind_end_steam_age"
		desc = "oe_v45_ind_end_steam_age_desc"
		trigger = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_v45_ind_index }
				var:oe_v45_ind_index >= 85
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v45_ind_ended value = 1 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
					OR = {
						is_ai = no
						is_great_power = yes
						has_variable = oe_v45_ind_pioneer
					}
				}
				add_prestige = 15
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v45_mod_ind_steam_age years = 30 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 2: Master-Artisan & Guild Synthesis (late era without steam takeoff)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v45_ind_end_artisan_synthesis"
		desc = "oe_v45_ind_end_artisan_synthesis_desc"
		trigger = {
			current_year >= 1825
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_v45_ind_index }
				var:oe_v45_ind_index < 45
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v45_ind_ended value = 2 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
					OR = {
						is_ai = no
						is_great_power = yes
						has_variable = oe_v45_ind_pioneer
					}
				}
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v45_mod_ind_artisan_synthesis years = 25 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 3: Threshold of the Machine Century (1836 campaign horizon)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v45_ind_end_industrial_horizon"
		desc = "oe_v45_ind_end_industrial_horizon_desc"
		trigger = {
			current_year >= 1836
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v45_ind_ended value = 3 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
					OR = {
						is_ai = no
						is_great_power = yes
						has_variable = oe_v45_ind_pioneer
					}
				}
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v45_mod_ind_steam_age years = 20 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	on_start = {
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_v45_ind_started value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_v45_ind_index value = 20 }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = no
				is_rebel_country = no
				NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_v45_ws_19_seen }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_v45_ws_19_seen value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_v45_ind_pioneer value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_v45_ws_ev_cd value = 1 days = 420 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_v45_ws.19
		}
	}

	on_monthly = {
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v45_ind_index } } set_variable = { name = oe_v45_ind_index value = 20 } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:oe_v45_ind_index < 78
				any_country = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					OR = {
						has_country_modifier = oe_v45_mod_steam_pump_engineering
						has_country_modifier = oe_v45_mod_coal_iron_canals
						has_country_modifier = oe_v45_mod_polytechnic_academy
					}
				}
			}
			change_variable = { name = oe_v45_ind_index add = 0.30 }
		}
		if = { limit = { var:oe_v45_ind_index > 100 } set_variable = { name = oe_v45_ind_index value = 100 } }
		if = { limit = { var:oe_v45_ind_index < 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_v45_ind_index value = 0 } }
	}

	on_ended = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v45_ind_ended } }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v45_ind_ended value = 3 }
		}
	}

	tooltip = {
		if = {
			limit = { raw_material ?= goods:coal }
			custom_tooltip = oe_v45_ind_map_coal_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { raw_material ?= goods:iron }
			custom_tooltip = oe_v45_ind_map_iron_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						has_variable = oe_v45_ind_pioneer
						average_country_literacy >= 35
					}
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v45_ind_map_pioneer_tt
		}
	}

	is_data_map = yes
	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = { raw_material ?= goods:coal }
			value = orange
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { raw_material ?= goods:iron }
			value = grey
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						has_variable = oe_v45_ind_pioneer
						average_country_literacy >= 35
					}
				}
			}
			value = green
		}
		else = {
			value = define:NMapColors|DEFAULT_COLOR
		}
	}

	legend_key = {
		desc = "oe_v45_ind_legend_coal"
		color = rgb { 224 128 42 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "oe_v45_ind_legend_iron"
		color = rgb { 94 126 158 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "oe_v45_ind_legend_pioneer"
		color = rgb { 62 154 124 }
	}
}
